description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
